name: 湿球温度（Stull 经验式）计算器

map.由气温与相对湿度，按 Stull(2011) 经验多项式估算湿球温度，适用 5–: Estimate the wet-bulb temperature from air temperature and relative humidity via the Stull (2011) empirical polynomial, applicable to 5-95% RH and -20-50°C.
map.📖 查看「湿球温度 T_w 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Wet-Bulb Temperature T_w User Guide"
map.Stull 2011 单方程近似，免迭代，工程与气象科普常用。: Stull 2011 single-equation approximation, iteration-free, commonly used in engineering and meteorological outreach.
map.算湿球温度（蒸发冷却极限）。: compute the wet-bulb temperature (the evaporative cooling limit).
map.30°C、相对湿度 70%：Stull 近似湿球≈25.6°C；湿度越低湿球越低: 30°C, relative humidity 70%: Stull approximation wet-bulb ≈25.6°C; the lower the humidity, the lower the wet-bulb (stronger evaporation), and at saturation the wet-bulb = air temperature.
map.湿球 35°C 是人体散热极限（无法靠出汗降温），虽罕见但极端湿热下致命，湿球: A wet-bulb of 35°C is the human heat-dissipation limit (cooling by sweating fails); though rare, it is fatal under extreme heat and humidity, and a wet-bulb above 28°C already means high-risk work.
map.湿球和体感一样吗？: Is the wet-bulb the same as the apparent temperature?
map.不同。湿球是「蒸发到极限的温度」，是物理量；体感是综合感受，WBGT 才含湿球作: No. The wet-bulb is "the temperature when evaporation reaches its limit", a physical quantity; the apparent temperature is a composite sensation, and only WBGT includes the wet-bulb as a heat-stress index.
map.极少，需极高湿热；一旦出现户外活动极危险，是气候临界点研究方向。: Rarely, and it requires extremely hot and humid conditions; if it occurs, outdoor activity is extremely dangerous, and it is a research direction for climate tipping points.
map.如何使用湿球温度 T_w: How to use Wet-Bulb Temperature T_w
map.湿球温度 T_w是做什么的？: What does Wet-Bulb Temperature T_w do?
map.如何使用湿球温度 T_w？: How do I use Wet-Bulb Temperature T_w?
map.湿球温度 T_w适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Wet-Bulb Temperature T_w suitable for?
map.湿球温度 T_w 是水分蒸发达到绝热饱和时的温度，反映体感凉爽上限与蒸发降温潜力: The wet-bulb temperature T_w is the temperature when water evaporation reaches adiabatic saturation, reflecting the upper limit of cooling and the evaporative cooling potential; the larger the wet-bulb depression, the drier and the stronger the evaporation.
map.评估热应激与人体散热极限（湿球≈35℃ 为生理耐受上限）、灌溉与 HVAC 设计: Assess heat stress and the human heat-dissipation limit (a wet-bulb ≈35°C is the physiological tolerance ceiling), irrigation and HVAC design.
map.由干球、湿度、气压估算；不同公式（Stull 等）误差约 ±0.3℃，精密气象以: Estimated from dry-bulb, humidity and pressure; different formulas (Stull etc.) have an error of about ±0.3°C, and precise meteorology relies on measured wet-bulb values.
